incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming tail p99 spiked to 5.8s for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2). Error rate 0.4%. Trigger: p99>5s for 5m. Paging on-call.
eli_oncall: acked. I'm on it, grabbing runbook and metrics. Can someone post quick logs?
maya_eng: looking at runtime traces — we see many connections stuck in "write" state, backpressure at proxy. kv-cache shows large prefix hits, but chunk flushes delayed.
samir_sre: I'm seeing proxy queuing latency rising (proxy.write_ms p95=120, p99=1800). Possible slow consumers or Nagle/coalescing. Any recent deploys to streaming-proxy?
eli_oncall: no deploys in last 30m. infra-bot: deploy bot: no active rollouts.
maya_eng: attaching brief logs:
```
[stream-proxy] WARN chunk_send: client_write_timeout after 3200ms id=0x7f2a
[upstream] INFO send_chunk size=512 delay=3100ms route=dedicated-gpu-3
```
eli_oncall: customers impacted?
katie_support: CS reports two customers with timed-out sessions (cust: acme-inc, cust: happychat). Support ticket IDs: #3456 #3457. Both using long-stream flows with large initial prompts.
samir_sre: hypothesis: a subset of clients are slow consumers, causing head-of-line blocking in proxy's write loop. Options: 1) evict slow clients, 2) increase proxy worker threads, 3) enable aggressive partial-flush on runtime.
eli_oncall: start with evict + partial-flush. maya can we enable partial-flush flag and reduce chunk size to 256 bytes? Samir do evict command.
maya_eng: toggling runtime feature: `POST /admin/flags?partial_flush=true&chunk_size=256` — done. Watching metrics.
samir_sre: evicting long-sitting connections older than 60s: `curl -X POST http://proxy-admin/evict?age=60` — executed. Evicted ~120 conns.
eli_oncall: rolling config change to proxy to bump write buffers: `kubectl -n streaming set env deploy/proxy PROXY_WRITE_BUF=2MB` — rolled to 3/3 pods.
maya_eng: partial-flush active. initial telemetry: chunk latency p95 dropped from ~600ms to ~200ms within 20s.
katie_support: customers updated: acme-inc still saw one failure but reconnected; happychat recovered.
samir_sre: monitoring p95/p99: p95=210ms, p99=1.1s, error rate -> 0.1%.
eli_oncall: good. Keeping paging open for 30m watch. Oncall: eli_oncall taking lead, handing to maya for postmortem. Please capture timeline and mitigation steps.
maya_eng: capturing runbook notes and will open incident ticket with timeline + root-cause suspects (slow-consumer head-of-line, proxy write coalescing).
infra-bot: incident-ticket created: INC-2026-789, severity=sev2.
eli_oncall: thanks all. If p99 creeps above 2s reopen paging. After 30m watch confirm stable then demobilize.
samir_sre: adding follow-up action items: add automated slow-client eviction threshold, expose per-conn write latency in dashboard, and test partial-flush under load.
katie_support: will follow up with customers and attach logs to tickets.
eli_oncall: demobilizing in 30m unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
